releases.name: v0.1.19 — explicit note add and id 0
releases.body:
## What's new in 0.1.19

- `note_add` appends a note; `note_write` patches one by `id`, so the two operations no longer share a single tool.
- `todo_write` accepts `id: 0` as a new task, the same as omitting `id`.

![The /todo dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LeonVeganMan/opencode-todo-md/master/screen/todo.png)

## Install

```json
{ "plugins": ["opencode-todo-md"] }
```

The TUI half (sidebar strip and `/todo`) loads at TUI startup: restart `opencode`, or run `/reload`.

79 unit tests. MIT.

releases.name: v0.1.18 — project notes with reminders
releases.body:
## What's new in 0.1.18

- `opencode-notes.md` keeps project ideas and reminders with stable ids, `@tags` and an optional time.
- `/note` captures a note, `/note` opens the list: filters by due date and tag, `/` search, `s` snooze 5/30/60 minutes,
  `ctrl+n`/`ctrl+e`/`ctrl+d` to add, edit and delete.
- `note_read`, `note_write` and `note_delete` give the agent the same notes across sessions.
- The sidebar lists the notes above the todo list, collapsible, with due reminders in red; reminders fire a toast every
  30 seconds while the TUI is open.

![The /todo dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LeonVeganMan/opencode-todo-md/master/screen/todo.png)

## Install

```json
{ "plugins": ["opencode-todo-md"] }
```

The TUI half (sidebar strip and `/todo`) loads at TUI startup: restart `opencode`, or run `/reload`.

78 unit tests. MIT.

releases.name: v0.1.17 — renumber order and undo
releases.body:
## What's new in 0.1.17

- `ctrl+z` restores the last deleted task at its original position, and `ctrl+g` renumbers the ids without leaving the list.
- `/todo renumber` orders ids by priority and then due date, with completed and cancelled tasks last.
- The default list order follows the same rule, so the panel and the ids agree.
- Every column sort keeps open tasks on top and closed ones at the bottom; `prio` breaks ties on the nearest due date.

![The /todo dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LeonVeganMan/opencode-todo-md/master/screen/todo.png)

## Install

```json
{ "plugins": ["opencode-todo-md"] }
```

The TUI half (sidebar strip and `/todo`) loads at TUI startup: restart `opencode`, or run `/reload`.

66 unit tests. MIT.

releases.name: v0.1.16 — click targets and stable order
releases.body:
## Click where you mean

0.1.16 makes the list behave the way it looks.

- **The description opens the editor**, exactly like `#id`. Only the `st` cell cycles a task through pending →
  in progress → completed.
- **Rows no longer jump** while the dialog is open: a state or priority click updates the row in place. The list
  re-sorts the next time you open it.

![The todo editor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LeonVeganMan/opencode-todo-md/master/screen/editor.png)

## Install

```json
{ "plugins": ["opencode-todo-md"] }
```

The TUI half (sidebar strip and `/todo`) loads at TUI startup: restart `opencode`, or run `/reload`.

63 unit tests. MIT.

releases.name: v0.1.15 — state cycling and editor wrap
releases.body:
## Click the state, read the whole task

0.1.15 makes the list faster to drive and the editor usable for long descriptions.

- **Click cycles the state**: clicking the `st` cell or the description walks pending → in progress → completed → pending (cancelled goes back to pending). `space` does the same on the selected task.
- **`in progress` filter** in the tab bar, so the work in flight is one key away.
- **Seven-line editor**: the description is a focused box that wraps long text instead of scrolling it sideways. A pasted newline becomes a space, so a task stays one line in `TODO.md`.
- **English due labels**: `today`, `+7d`, `+30d`, and the hint fits the dialog again.

![The todo editor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LeonVeganMan/opencode-todo-md/master/screen/editor.png)

## Install

```json
{ "plugins": ["opencode-todo-md"] }
```

The TUI half (sidebar strip and `/todo`) loads at TUI startup: restart `opencode`, or run `/reload`.

63 unit tests. MIT.
